svg.text: 2 Validity assessment: gates grouped by the evidence each one requires
Gate FAIL or CAUTION → investigate; not by itself proof of invalid labels
Check: training collapse and corpus size · class imbalance · metadata or template leakage
· provenance and generation process · taxonomy alignment · threshold sensitivity
If unresolved: restrict use, revise the corpus, or collect new labels
model class used to compute a gate
corpus-level gates: G0b, G0, G1 · target-level gates: G2, G3, G4
